title: Barium-promoted ruthenium catalysts on yittria-stabilized zirconia supports for ammonia synthesis
extraction_notes: No extractable SI catalyst-performance records with an absolute NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF were found. SI Figure S2 reports conversion as a function of catalyst weight under stated conditions, but the provided SI text gives no numerical conversion/rate values and conversion is not one of the requested extracted performance fields. SI Figure S3 reports only normalized NH3 synthesis rate versus time for Ru/YSZ, without an absolute rate, outlet NH3, or TOF; it was not extracted. SI Figure S1 is loading/characterization, and SI pages 5-9 contain CHEMKIN input/mechanism data, which are out of scope.
